title: Introducing Vibecraft, a vibe coded voxel RPG that runs on WebGPU in your browser
author: astlouis44

comments.author: Free-Breadfruit9378
comments.body: ah.. another game that is just like minecraft but worse.

comments.author: sirpalee
comments.body: It's impressive for a vibe-coded prototype, but as a game, it is \*VERY\* rough. Keep on vibing and improving it. :)

replies.author: astlouis44
replies.body: Thank you very much! Took me around an hour to make that. What are some suggestions for features that you would like to see?

replies.author: sirpalee
replies.body:
That's you mate. It is your game and vision.

I would focus on the technical issues first, like the stuttering and hangs when new chunks are streamed in. Once it got a bit more solid foundation, you can start adding new features one by one and refining existing ones. UI, cracting, things not going through the terrain, improving graphics, design etc.

comments.body: It's really dark. Also, what did you use to make this, if I may ask?

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body: Oh, that's Meta's website? Does that mean you used their Llama LLM?

replies.author: astlouis44
replies.body: No, Manus uses Claude and Qwen under the hood. It was only recently acquired by Meta so presumably they’ll switch over to Llama or their upcoming “Avocado” model at some point. Personally, hope they stick with Claude + Qwen as it’s a very effective combo that gets the job done.
